policy: Manual agent branch/feature review completeness. This supplements but does not replace differential and end-to-end parity evidence.

limitations: This logical unit contains immutable numeric tables and no C function definitions; draw-time use is reviewed separately in gl_rmain.

open_findings: The isolated CL_UpdateTEnts pendant creates the original progs/bolt.mdl, progs/bolt2.mdl, progs/bolt3.mdl, and progs/beam.mdl entities every 30 units, but the live Host path stores only endpoint events in client_effects.processTemporary and render/particles.renderTemporary emits one GL_LINES primitive. The production renderer must consume the segmented model entities, including per-segment roll and MAX_TEMP_ENTITIES/MAX_VISEDICTS truncation, before this unit can pass.
limitations: The pinned differential proves all five cl_tent.c bodies in the isolated pendant; the explicit production call-path finding prevents that fixture from being misreported as live renderer parity.

The original helper owns a blocking Win32 worker thread. MiniQuake preserves QHOST decoding in MiniLang and services the synchronous protocol through a non-blocking native event wait on each dedicated-console pass; request/response integration is covered, while interoperability with an external historical QHOST executable remains an end-to-end gate.

The original optional glquake/*.ms2 disk cache and hunk-relative copied pose block are represented by a process-local immutable AliasMesh cache over the source poses. The generated primitive commands, reordered vertex indices, pose-vertex count, and rendered result are equivalent; no public Quake file or wire format depends on .ms2.
StrAddr is compiled only under the disabled DEBUG block in the pinned source and is an inventory exclusion.

The WinSock send/receive calls are private native platform bridges; framing, sequencing, retry, discovery, and control-packet policy remain in MiniLang and are exercised through real two-process UDP tests.
Master-server, NAT traversal, IPX, serial/modem, and VCR networking are outside the declared GLQuake Windows-x64 target.
The loop driver's observable byte records, backpressure, discovery, and lifetime semantics are preserved; MiniLang stores queued records as typed byte arrays instead of pointer-aligned C memory.
The Visual Studio resource-editor bookkeeping macros have no runtime counterpart.

The x64 bridge registers a generic Windows application icon and creates the OpenGL window directly instead of showing the historical resource-only 'Starting Quake...' dialog and obsolete one-time 15-bit-palette progress dialog.
